headline: Athens Stock Exchange: Banks and Blue Chips Under Pressure
summary: The Athens Stock Exchange fell under pressure in banks and blue chips as rising bond yields and oil prices weighed on sentiment and sell-offs intensified.
why: The Athens bourse is Greece's main equity market, where large banks and blue-chip companies make up much of the index's weight.
why_moved: Rising bond yields and oil prices weighed on sentiment, and sell-offs intensified in banks and blue chips.
